title: Home sessions without the floor
description: See in advance which sessions are seated or use support, what items are needed, and a large demonstration of the movements.

blocks.text: A “for seniors” label doesn’t answer whether you will have to get down on the floor. A person needs a session format that is clear in advance and matches the conditions they chose.

quote.text: No chair exercises for seniors. A lot of the “senior” workouts included floor exercises. If I get down on the floor, I’m not able to get back up again LOL.

blocks.text: Select by positions, not by an age label

In the selection, show which sessions are seated, standing or with support, and list the transitions. Let someone see a large demonstration and pause it before the next movement. If a session has a part on the floor, mark it in advance.

One suitable cover doesn’t guarantee suitable transitions in the middle of the clip. The content has to be reviewed in full with specialist authors and with the target audience, without promising that everyone of the same age will find it equally doable.
